evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2020-01-01"} returned 201 with dueDate "2020-01-01". The date has no time part. A POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null, so the field is optional.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/2 with {"dueDate":"2021-05-05"} returned 200 and the date changed to 2021-05-05. PATCH with {"dueDate":null} returned 200 and the date became null (removed). A later PATCH with a new date set it again.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30" returned 400. POST with "01.02.2026" returned 400. POST with "2026-02-28T10:00:00" returned 400. PATCH with "2026-13-01" returned 400. Each response was {"error":"dueDate must be a YYYY-MM-DD date"}.
evidence.AC4: Today (UTC) is 2026-11-01. I created these todos: past (2020-01-01, not done), future (2099-01-01), today (2026-11-01), nodate, and pastdone (2020-01-01, then marked done). GET /todos?overdue=true returned only "past". The future, today, no-date and done todos were excluded. GET /todos returned all 5.
evidence.AC5: The browser snapshot of / showed "fällig 2020-01-01" for past, "fällig 2099-01-01" for future, "fällig 2026-11-01" for today and "fällig 2020-01-01" for pastdone. The nodate todo showed no date.
evidence.AC6: In the page snapshot, only the "past" item (not done, due 2020-01-01) carried the text "überfällig". The future, today, nodate and pastdone (done) items did not.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled "nur überfällige". After I clicked it, the list showed only the "past" todo, marked überfällig. The other four todos disappeared.
